headline: Key Points of the PSOE Electoral Program: 1% of GDP for Housing, Enshrining Pensions and Abortion, More Work-Life Balance, and the 'Friendship Union'
summary: The PSOE electoral programme for the 29 November vote rests on six axes, including pensions, housing, work-life balance and self-employed workers. It commits 1% of GDP to housing.
why: Spain's election outcome shapes fiscal policy, housing spending and labour rules, which matter for Spanish government bond yields and domestic sectors.
